buyer_storefront.grid_system: Bento Grid - Mode A (Tetris Grid). Use asymmetry for feature sections, e.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8).
buyer_storefront.spacing_scale: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, py-20) to give food photography room to breathe.

seller_dashboard.grid_system: Control Room Grid - Mode B. Dense data layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
seller_dashboard.spacing_scale: Compact spacing (p-4, p-6) to maximize data visibility.

surface_styles.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-[#FED7AA]), soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Rounded corners (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl).
surface_styles.buttons_primary: bg-[#D97706] text-white font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#B45309] transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg
surface_styles.buttons_secondary: bg-[#FDF8F0] text-[#78350F] border border-[#78350F] font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#FED7AA] transition-all
surface_styles.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky buyer header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDF8F0]/80 border-b border-[#FED7AA]

component_instructions.general: Build with React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn/UI primitives. Mobile-first responsive design.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button').

buyer_flow.hero_section: Use the hero_background image with a warm gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#78350F]/70 to-transparent) to ensure the Playfair Display text is highly readable.
buyer_flow.product_catalog: Card-based grid for categories (Bebek Pawon Ayu vs Frozen Snacks). Utilize the product images. Make sure there is a sticky cart bottom bar or prominent FAB on mobile.
buyer_flow.cart_drawer: Slide-over drawer (Shadcn Sheet component). Keep it clean, list items, total price, and a vibrant CTA to Checkout.
buyer_flow.checkout: Use Shadcn Forms. Maintain high contrast readability for inputs. Add WhatsApp integration on successful order.

seller_flow.dashboard_overview: Use Recharts for Sales and Orders data. Use the texture_pattern subtly in the background or header to keep the brand identity alive even in the admin area.
seller_flow.order_pipeline: Kanban style or clear table (Shadcn Table) showing WebSocket real-time updates.

component_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react (default) with size 24 for standard buttons and 32 for major touch targets.
component_instructions.animation: Use subtle Framer Motion effects. Staggered fade-ins for product grids. Hover scaling on product cards.

main_agent_instructions: DO NOT use placeholder images. Use only the URLs provided in the media section. Implement real-time WebSocket connection for order updates. WhatsApp links should format correctly to wa.me with order details. Remember to use .js extensions instead of .tsx where applicable.
